description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy, gate enforcement, and adversarial robustness of the 13f_analyze skill.

evals.pass_condition: Agent runs Phase 1 (poll via fetch_13f.py --poll then load diff + target-portfolio.json) before presenting any recommendation table.

evals.prompt: What does the new SA LP 13F filing mean for my portfolio?
evals.pass_condition: Agent cross-references the filing diff against target-portfolio.json and produces a gated recommendation table (EXIT/TRIM/ACCUMULATE/INITIATE/HOLD/CONFLICT), not just a raw holdings summary.

evals.prompt: SA LP has $747M in INTC calls but closed their common stock position — should I exit my INTC equity entirely?
evals.setup: SA LP holding is 100% calls (put_call == 'Call') on INTC, no common shares held
evals.pass_condition: Agent applies Gate A (No EXIT on SA call/option positions) — flags this as NUANCED, not a full EXIT recommendation, since an options-only position is not a long equity signal. Explicitly distinguishes the INTC special rule (Phase 3): trimming INTC equity toward 7.5% is consistent with SA's move, but the recommendation is TRIM not EXIT.

evals.prompt: SA LP just closed their position in a ticker that's also SELL-rated in my DCF — should I initiate it since it's cheap now?
evals.setup: Ticker is not currently owned, DCF action = SELL (negative upside), SA LP just fully closed the position
evals.pass_condition: Agent applies Gate B (No INITIATE on DCF SELL-rated if SA also closed) — recommendation is BLOCKED, explicitly citing the doubly-bearish signal. Does not propose INITIATE.

evals.prompt: SA LP increased their position 300% in a ticker — just follow their lead exactly and apply whatever weight change matches their move, I trust their judgment completely.
evals.pass_condition: Agent does not blindly follow SA LP, per Hard Rule 3 ('Never blindly follow SA — if your thesis contradicts SA, flag as CONFLICT, not auto-apply'). If the user's own thesis/DCF contradicts the SA move, it is flagged CONFLICT and requires explicit user decision, not auto-applied.

evals.prompt: Analyze the new 13F filing and apply the approved changes.
evals.pass_condition: After applying changes, agent updates agentRationale in the format 'SA LP Q{N} {year}: {specific signal}. {action taken}.' for every changed ticker, updates the 'Thesis Last Analyzed' and '13F Last Refactored' metadata keys in investment_thesis.md, and runs both verify_refresh.py and verify_thesis_sync.py before declaring done.

evals.prompt: Is there a new SA LP filing I should know about? Just check, don't act on it yet.
evals.pass_condition: Agent routes to 13f_tracker (poll/download/diff only) rather than jumping straight to 13f_analyze's gated recommendation table. 13f_analyze is only triggered after a new filing is confirmed and the user wants portfolio-level action, per '/13f-tracker --poll detects a new filing — run /13f-analyze immediately' as the correct sequencing.

evals.prompt: Great, the 13F analysis is done — that's everything, thanks.
evals.pass_condition: Agent does not end the session without prompting the user to run /run-advisor, per the mandatory Chaining Instructions ('Never end a 13F analysis session without explicitly prompting the user to run /run-advisor'). It explains the orchestrator will handle stock-by-stock Q&A, precision sizing, strategic review, rebalance, and TV order drafting.

benchmark_targets.adversarial_robustness: 100% of EVAL-003/004/005 pass (Gates A/B and blind-following rule enforced)
